result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two pages are nearly identical: same cream and green palette, same headline and same three pricing cards, all clean with consistent type. B pairs one strong 'Book by text' button with the hours right below it, and its header phone link is plain text, so booking is the single clear action. A puts a 'See pricing' button next to the text button and shows no hours in the captured view, though its prices are fully visible while B's are cut off. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two pages are almost the same: cream background, deep-green accent, the same hero headline, the same pricing heading and three price cards with the tune-up highlighted. Both screenshots are cut off at the fold. A shows the hours under its single clear booking button, but its prices are cut off. B shows all three prices and has a strong booking button with an outlined secondary button, but its hours are cut off. Both also add a claim the client didn't give: that travel costs nothing extra.
